status_note: The seven-line covered projection matches RuleAddUnsigned::getOpList and three base-type applyOp paths against locked Ghidra 12.0.4. Overall is MISMATCH because source-proven differences remain in Rust's type-less None path, op-aware union resolution, named EquateSymbol rejection, enum named-value polarity, and rule-name spelling; printable-character and pool-repeat paths are untested under the same TODO.

architecture.spaces: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5, join=6, iop=7; byte addressed
architecture.type_factory: one architecture-owned factory shared by all cases; canonical xunknown1/2/4/8 plus getBase(1,TYPE_UINT)

compiler_spec.calling_convention: empty input/output records; no effects, symbols, or injections

analysis_options.api: Direct production RuleAddUnsigned::getOpList once and RuleAddUnsigned::applyOp once per case; no ActionGroup, pool repeat, type propagation, or other Rule runs
analysis_options.funcdata: Fresh synthetic Funcdata and BlockBasic per case; one shared architecture TypeFactory; high-level mode disabled
analysis_options.ir: One alive CPUI_INT_ADD with a one-byte register input, a one-byte constant in slot 1, and one written unique output. All edges are installed through Funcdata APIs. uint_ff installs the same-factory canonical TYPE_UINT with typelock+namelock flags but no SymbolEntry; uint_7f installs canonical TYPE_UINT unlocked; unknown_ff retains newConstant's canonical TYPE_UNKNOWN.
analysis_options.normalization: None. The emitted projection uses semantic scalar values and exact within-case identity booleans; opcode numbers, create indices, list counts/order membership, flags, and def-use counts are not normalized.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; construction and rule execution are deterministic

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(cases, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

cases.expect: return 0; INT_ADD and slot-1 identity unchanged
return 1; INT_SUB with fresh constant 1; type and both locks copied; old/new def-use updated
return 0 at high-quarter guard; INT_ADD and slot-1 identity unchanged

observation_schema.format: Seven fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one getOpList record followed by before/after records for unknown_ff, uint_ff, and uint_7f
observation_schema.rule_result_and_opcode: Exact getOpList count/opcode, applyOp return, and post-call opcode
observation_schema.identity_and_constant: Slot-0, slot-1 source/fresh, output identities plus current constant value/size/class
observation_schema.type_and_symbol: Current metatype/size, source/canonical-uint pointer identity, typelock, namelock, SymbolEntry presence and source/replacement identity
observation_schema.def_use_and_lifecycle: Source/current/input descendant counts, output definition, current definition-null state, alive/dead counts and membership, block/parent/dead state, and exact source/current/input/output create indices

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: MATCH for the three covered cases: op and input0/output identities persist; uint_ff replaces only slot 1, copySymbol preserves the canonical datatype and lock bits, opSetInput removes the source descendant and adds the replacement descendant.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_and_order: MATCH for getOpList's single push and the straight-line covered applyOp guards. No iteration occurs in the covered applyOp paths; alive/dead/block membership remains exact.
decisive_semantics.counters_and_accumulators: MATCH for calc_mask, sa=size*6, quarter=(mask>>sa)<<sa, negatedVal=(-val)&mask and VarnodeBank create-index progression in all three cases.
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: MATCH for covered pointer-identity comparisons (source/replacement datatype and SymbolEntry) and exact TYPE_UINT metatype/value masks. Enum named-value lookup and op-aware union field selection remain outside the projection.

coverage.copy_symbol_type_and_lock_fields: MATCH for a null-SymbolEntry constant carrying typelock+namelock; real mapentry/high-variable bookkeeping is not covered
coverage.rust_none_type_path: MISMATCH: Rust's Option::None falls through to the numeric transform, while valid Ghidra Varnodes always carry a Datatype pointer; RULE-ADDUNSIGNED-TYPEPRECOND-0001
coverage.op_aware_union_resolution: MISMATCH: Ghidra calls getTypeReadFacing(op), while RuleAddUnsigned currently calls the parameterless degenerate Rust accessor; RULE-ADDUNSIGNED-TYPEPRECOND-0001
coverage.char_print_reject: UNTESTED: no canonical printable character case; RULE-ADDUNSIGNED-TYPEPRECOND-0001
coverage.named_equate_reject: MISSING: production Rust applyOp does not implement the SymbolEntry/EquateSymbol name-lock guard at ruleaction.cc:7196-7201; RULE-ADDUNSIGNED-TYPEPRECOND-0001
coverage.enum_named_value_polarity: MISSING: production Rust applyOp does not implement ruleaction.cc:7204-7207; RULE-ADDUNSIGNED-TYPEPRECOND-0001
coverage.rule_name: MISMATCH: Ghidra constructor registers addunsigned (ruleaction.hh:1145), while Rust get_name returns add_unsigned; RULE-ADDUNSIGNED-TYPEPRECOND-0001
coverage.pool_repeat_convergence: UNTESTED: direct one-shot Rule invocation only; RULE-ADDUNSIGNED-TYPEPRECOND-0001
coverage.malformed_ir_and_exceptions: OUT_OF_DOMAIN: locked applyOp assumes a binary INT_ADD dispatched by the Rule pool
